name: gemini-media
description: Generate and edit images and generate short videos with Google Gemini, using your own Gemini API key. Files are saved on your computer.
long_description:
Adds image generation, image editing and video generation to Claude Desktop through Google Gemini.

- **Your own key.** Paste your Gemini API key once in the settings. It is stored by Claude Desktop in the operating system's secure storage and is sent only to Google.
- **Files stay on your computer.** Results are saved to the folder you choose. Nothing is uploaded anywhere except the prompts and reference images that go to Google.
- **Spending cap.** A monthly cap in US dollars; when it is reached the tools refuse new requests until the next month.

Image and video models have no free tier: the key must belong to a Google AI Studio project with billing enabled. Do not send client data or personal data.

tools.name: generate_image
tools.description: Generate 1-4 images from a text description (1K, 2K or 4K) and save them on this computer.

tools.name: edit_image
tools.description: Edit or re-render images from this computer following written instructions; saves a new file.

tools.name: generate_video
tools.description: Start a 3-10 second video (16:9 or 9:16) from a description or a starting image.

tools.name: get_job
tools.description: Check a job and, when a video is ready, save it on this computer.

tools.name: usage
tools.description: Spending this month against the cap, and the current price list.

gemini_api_key.title: Gemini API key
gemini_api_key.description: Your key from Google AI Studio (API keys). It must belong to a project with billing enabled. Stored securely; sent only to Google.

output_dir.title: Save files to
output_dir.description: Folder on this computer where generated images and videos are saved.

monthly_cap_usd.title: Monthly spending cap (USD)
monthly_cap_usd.description: The tools refuse new requests once this month's estimated spending reaches this amount. Set 0 to block all spending.
